brief:
The head of Spain's public broadcasting authority, José Pablo López, has declared support for continuing the country's Eurovision boycott in response to Israel's participation, according to Shehab Wire. López has proposed extending Spain's suspension from the 2027 competition, which is scheduled to take place in a yet-unspecified location.

Spain previously withdrew from the song contest over the Israeli entry, marking an escalation in tensions surrounding the event's inclusivity and political dimensions.

title: Spain's public broadcaster backs Eurovision boycott over Israeli entry
